name: holdout_detector_disjoint_v2
description:
Detector-disjoint holdout subset v2 — 7 cases. Extends v1 (6 cases) with E-1 (elife_neurexin_fig1b). All cases: anomaly types NOT covered by the duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse detector family. Discovered via PubPeer / correction notices / retraction. Use to test whether B3 FAR generalises beyond detector training distribution.

Anomaly type breakdown:
  label_swap:              ncb_cav2
  misaligned_records:      ncb_clonalfish
  mislabeled_panel:        ncb_lphn3
  assignment_inconsistency: ncb_radioligand
  assignment_inconsistency: ncb_nickelate
  pseudoreplication:       ncb_spp1
  provenance_mismatch:     elife_neurexin_fig1b (E-1; eLife 78649 Fig1B cells 3/10 @100mA from prior analysis run)

Note: G-1 slot (figure-vs-source-data count mismatch) pending verification. Suite will extend to v3 if confirmed.
